title: overlay-r3: 124 PS3 sound banks converted to the PS4 SCREAM format, samples in their own codec (u3fix.exe sound-banks, sound-banks/convert_banks.cpp)
applied: 2026-10-27 15:51 (cloud b34.tar/glob.tar); converter rewritten 2026-11-05; samples kept in their own codec 2026-11-15
notes: Rewrites PS3 SBlk v4/v5 big-endian banks to SBlk v13 (rules re-derived 2026-11-05; envelope table adsr_env.json and its nearest-pair fallback are the original 2026-10-27 converter's). Since 1.21.0 every sample keeps its own codec with the PS4 sample header of that codec, as the retail PS4 banks have them: PS-ADPCM frames copied (the PS3 leading zero frame and what follows the end frame left out), MP3 kept as MP3 (0x10-byte header, then the PS3 0x80-byte MP3 header as little-endian words and the MPEG data), PCM16 byte-swapped; a grain with flag 0x40 loops. Samples start 16-byte aligned. No re-encoding and no ffmpeg: before 1.21.0 MP3 and PCM16 samples were decoded with ffmpeg and re-encoded to PS-ADPCM, which garbled many sounds, and without ffmpeg the 95 banks with MP3 samples were skipped. The reference sha256 of every bank is in banks_list.json; a bank at its reference is left alone. The Uncharted 2 import converts its banks with the same code (u2import, converter version 2). C++ (u3fix.exe sound-banks), no Python.
